SELECT r.role_id AS roleId, r.role_name AS roleName, COALESCE(NULLIF(r.remark, ''), CONCAT(r.role_name, '角色')) AS description, COALESCE(member_stats.member_count, 0) AS memberCount, CASE WHEN r.is_system = 1 OR COALESCE(member_stats.member_count, 0) > 0 THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS canDelete, DATE_FORMAT(r.updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt FROM pms_role r LEFT JOIN ( SELECT role_id, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM pms_member WHERE camp_id = #{campId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status = 1 GROUP BY role_id ) member_stats ON member_stats.role_id = r.role_id WHERE r.camp_id = #{campId} AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1
AND ( r.role_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR r.role_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY r.is_system DESC, r.role_id ASC

SELECT r.role_id AS roleId, r.role_name AS roleName, COALESCE(NULLIF(r.remark, ''), CONCAT(r.role_name, '角色')) AS description, COALESCE(member_stats.member_count, 0) AS memberCount, CASE WHEN r.is_system = 1 OR COALESCE(member_stats.member_count, 0) > 0 THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS canDelete, DATE_FORMAT(r.updated_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updatedAt FROM pms_role r LEFT JOIN ( SELECT role_id, COUNT(*) AS member_count FROM pms_member WHERE camp_id = #{campId} AND is_deleted = 0 AND status = 1 GROUP BY role_id ) member_stats ON member_stats.role_id = r.role_id WHERE r.camp_id = #{campId} AND r.role_id = #{roleId} AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 LIMIT 1

SELECT SUBSTRING_INDEX(ad.authority_code, ':', 1) AS moduleId, ad.module_name AS moduleName, CASE WHEN ad.authority_code LIKE '%:view' THEN '查看' WHEN ad.authority_code LIKE '%:edit' THEN '操作' WHEN ad.authority_code LIKE '%:config' THEN '配置' WHEN ad.authority_code LIKE '%:dispatch' THEN '派单' ELSE ad.authority_name END AS permissionLabel, ad.seq_no AS seqNo FROM pms_role_authority pra JOIN authority_dict ad ON ad.authority_id = pra.authority_id WHERE pra.camp_id = #{campId} AND pra.role_id = #{roleId} AND ad.status = 1 ORDER BY ad.seq_no ASC, ad.authority_id ASC

SELECT ad.authority_id AS authorityId, ad.authority_type AS authorityType, SUBSTRING_INDEX(ad.authority_code, ':', 1) AS moduleId, ad.module_name AS moduleName, CASE WHEN ad.authority_code LIKE '%:view' THEN '查看' WHEN ad.authority_code LIKE '%:edit' THEN '操作' WHEN ad.authority_code LIKE '%:config' THEN '配置' WHEN ad.authority_code LIKE '%:dispatch' THEN '派单' ELSE ad.authority_name END AS permissionLabel, ad.seq_no AS seqNo FROM authority_dict ad WHERE ad.status = 1 ORDER BY ad.seq_no ASC, ad.authority_id ASC

SELECT CAST(COALESCE(m.user_id, m.member_id) AS CHAR) AS userId, CAST(m.member_id AS CHAR) AS memberId, CAST(m.role_id AS CHAR) AS roleId, m.name AS displayName, m.name AS userName, m.name AS name, COALESCE(m.mobile, '') AS mobile FROM pms_member m WHERE m.camp_id = #{campId} AND m.is_deleted = 0 AND m.status = 1 ORDER BY m.member_id ASC
